name: Banishing You
source:
Bored of your mundane routine? Accept a mysterious invitation that whisks you away to a dream realm, filled with enigmatic characters and intriguing challenges. Navigate passive-aggressive comments, hidden motives, and unravel a quest that could save or doom both worlds.

In Banishing You you are summoned to a world of dreams and fears. Guided by one of four mysterious strangers you will have to decide the fate of both worlds - A decision that might proof fatal.

This game deals with insecurities, fears, hopes and dreams with optional romance sub plots.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2926910/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
厌倦了平凡的日常生活？接受神秘的邀请，带你前往充满神秘人物和有趣挑战的梦想王国。浏览消极攻击性的评论、隐藏的动机，并解开一个可能拯救或毁灭两个世界的任务。

在《放逐你》中，你被召唤到一个充满梦想和恐惧的世界。在四个神秘陌生人之一的指导下，你必须决定两个世界的命运 - 这个决定可能是致命的。

该游戏涉及不安全感、恐惧、希望和梦想以及可选的浪漫次要情节。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2926910/]Steam[/url]]
